evidence.observation: Pressure 2.897 Torr at Ar 100 sccm, in line with the ramp baseline of about 2.90
Pressure rose steadily to 3.175 Torr (+~9%) over 10 min of growth
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the rise is not caused by a flow change
Temperature holding at 750 °C after a small overshoot; heater power normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so the atmosphere required for growth cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or a leak-check/rate-of-rise test with the pump isolated, to tell an exhaust blockage (O2 flat) from a seal leak (O2 rising); also reference pressure statistics for normal growth.
